issue_title: Fields with `exclude_if` should not be required in serialization JSON schema
pr_title: Exclude fields with `exclude_if` from JSON Schema required fields

validator.fix_summary: In GenerateJsonSchema.field_is_required (pydantic/json_schema.py), the pre-fix code only excluded fields carrying the always-on 'serialization_exclude' flag from the required list (and only when json_schema_serialization_defaults_required was set). It never considered 'serialization_exclude_if', so conditionally-excluded fields were wrongly marked required in serialization-mode schemas. Independent fix: compute a base 'has_default' from field type/default (typed-dict-field uses required/total; others use schema type == 'default'), then in serialization mode subtract any field with a non-None 'serialization_exclude_if'. Under json_schema_serialization_defaults_required=True a field is required iff it has no exclude_if; otherwise required iff it has no default AND no exclude_if. Validation mode returns required iff no default (unchanged). Matches the official PR #12430 behavior. Verified: grade test passes and full tests/test_json_schema.py passes 526/531 (5 skipped, 1 xfailed).

notes.pydantic_core: pinned wheel 2.41.4 pulled by `pip install -e .` (pure-Python fix; no rust rebuild)
notes.why_extra_deps: conftest.py imports jsonschema; pyproject filterwarnings='error' turns the unknown 'thread_unsafe' mark (from pytest-run-parallel) into an INTERNALERROR unless the plugin is installed; pyproject addopts references pytest-benchmark options. Installing these plugins lets pytest run with the repo's native config (no -o addopts override needed).
notes.gotcha_addopts: If pytest-benchmark / pytest-run-parallel are NOT installed, you must pass `-o addopts=""` to strip the benchmark flags, AND the 'thread_unsafe' mark will error under filterwarnings=error. Installing both plugins (done in all venvs) avoids both problems - grading runs with plain native config.
notes.test_rename: The PR renamed the old test 'test_serialization_schema_with_exclude' to 'test_serialization_schema_with_exclude_exclude_if'; the grade node id is the new name. The old name no longer exists after tests.patch.
